name: Skyworth SWTV-24AE-4K NF
summary: Skyworth SWTV-24AE-4K NF ships with telemetry, ad services and content rows. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This Skyworth set sells in South Africa and runs Google TV on Android 14 with about 1 GB of memory. It ships with Skyworth telemetry and activation, Android ad and personalisation services, and content rows and analytics. The list also covers regional broadcast extras and streaming apps not used here.

It was applied in batches with a screenshot after each. Home, the inputs (HDMI 1, 2, 3 and Composite), Settings and the app grid all worked, and every change survived a full restart. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The inputs, including HDMI 1 to 3 and Composite
Chromecast, which does not depend on the setup helper
notes: This model offers only Wireless debugging. After a restart, Android switches it off again, so turn it back on in Developer options.
The stock home screen is switched off last, after the new one is installed and checked.

faq.q: Does casting still work on my Skyworth?
faq.a: Yes. Chromecast was checked and does not depend on the setup helper.

faq.q: Do the changes survive a restart?
faq.a: Yes. All the changes survived a full restart on this set.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
